messages:
emma: Quick sync — landing copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need hero variants, one-liners, and CTA routing (trial vs sales). Goal: finish copy + CTAs by EOD Fri for dev preview. Thoughts?

raj: On it. I'll draft three hero lines, focused on latency/cost/reliability.

sarah: I'll map CTAs to inbound routing + HubSpot forms. Want talk tracks for benchmarks in hero? e.g., '99th percentile latency Xms' or should we keep high-level?

emma: Keep hero simple. Benchmarks in sub-hero or snapshot cards. We need one hero that works for PLG landing and another enterprise-focused.

mike: Proposed hero — Hosted: 'Start low-latency LLM inference in minutes' CTA: Start free -> routing: self-serve. Dedicated: 'Predictable throughput. Reserved GPU capacity.' CTA: Contact sales -> lead form. Private: 'Deploy behind your VPC for compliance' CTA: Schedule demo. Thoughts?

olga: Love it. For benchmarks subcopy, can we call out typical cost savings and sample latency on T4/A100? Need legal check.

raj: Drafting hero variants now. Quick options:
1) 'Ship LLM features — fast, reliable, cost-aware.'
2) 'Inference that scales: from dev to enterprise.'
Which one tilts more PLG?

emma: Option 1 for PLG, option 2 for enterprise. Let's keep both.

nina: Webinar plug: 'Join our launch webinar: serving at scale' — can we tie to hero with a small 'See benchmarks' link. I can run the registration flow.

sarah: Inbound routing - mapping: Hosted -> MQL free trial sign-up; Dedicated -> SQL (sales outreach); Private -> Enterprise lead (AE + Solutions). I'll create HubSpot forms and hidden fields (region, expected RPS).

raj: I'll update copy doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/copy/landing-pass-1 (placeholder).

copybot: drafts: uploaded hosted-hero-v1.md, dedicated-hero-v1.md, private-hero-v1.md

emma: We need variants for hero CTAs A/B test: 'Start free' vs 'Try hosted' for PLG. Can someone add to experiment sheet?

mike: I'll add to experiment sheet and flag tracking events (landing.cta_click).

olga: For benchmark language: 'up to 3x cost saving vs naive CPU hosting' — legal/ops: is '3x' safe? Should we say 'up to' + link to methodology.

emma: Call legal loop; add methodology link. Also add small 'deployment chooser' microcopy to guide users picking Hosted/Dedicated/Private.

raj: Adding microcopy: Hosted = quick dev -> 'API keys, start in minutes'; Dedicated = stable throughput -> 'reserve capacity, SLAs'; Private = compliance -> 'VPC & on-prem options'.

nina: I'll slot a CTA in webinar live: 'See benchmarks & live demo' that routes to hosted doc + sign-up.

sarah: Timeline reminder: copy final by Friday EOD; dev to implement by next Tues. Ping me for form fields.

emma: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Small next step: raj + sarah to collate hero + routing doc. I'll review tonight.

deploy-bot: doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/copy/landing-pass-1 updated by raj at 1719999000

raj: done. pushed edits. will add A/B options.
